# WHAT THE PUBLIC SITE IS MADE OF — the deploy allow-list.
#
# Every path here is copied to the Cloudflare Pages artifact. Anything in the
# repository that is NOT listed here is not deployed, and cannot become
# deployed by being added to the repo.
#
# This replaced a deny-list of --exclude flags, which had the failure mode you
# would expect: every new top-level file or directory was public BY DEFAULT and
# the only thing standing between it and the internet was a guard that failed
# the whole build. On 2026-08-14 that is exactly what happened — .claude/agents/
# arrived, the markdown guard fired, and the public site stopped following
# master for four merges while the Worker kept deploying, so the two halves of
# the system drifted apart without anything saying so.
#
# The guard was right. The list was wrong. With an allow-list a new agent
# definition, handoff note or tooling directory is simply not site content, and
# the deploy is unaffected.
#
# Live is served from the repo root, so a path listed here appears at the same
# path on the domain: `intake` -> /intake/.
#
# ADDING A PAGE: add its path here, or it will not be published — and the stager
# fails loudly if a listed path is missing, so a renamed directory is caught at
# build time rather than by someone noticing a 404 weeks later.
#
# NOT LISTED, DELIBERATELY: .claude (agent definitions), .github (workflows,
# this file, the stager and its test), case-portal (Worker source, PRICING.md,
# the handoff and reconciliation notes), visitor-alerts (Worker source),
# build-locations.py (the generator; its OUTPUT is published, not the script),
# CLAUDE.md and README.md, and .gitignore.

# --- Cloudflare Pages configuration -----------------------------------------
_headers
_redirects

# --- the site itself ---------------------------------------------------------
index.html
404.html
privacy.html
robots.txt
sitemap.xml
beacon.js
assets
.well-known

# --- service pages -----------------------------------------------------------
insurance-investigations
infidelity-investigations
child-custody-investigations

# --- generated location pages (build-locations.py writes these) --------------
private-investigator

# --- the intake form ---------------------------------------------------------
intake

# --- the staff case portal (noindex; a page, not the Worker) -----------------
portal

# --- the private visitor dashboard (noindex) ---------------------------------
watch
